name: KENT Automatic Water Softener 8L
summary: The KENT Automatic Water Softener 8L is a fully automatic wall-mounted water softener that efficiently removes calcium and magnesium from hard water using ion-exchange technology.
benefits: Soft water for everyday household use
Protects plumbing fixtures and water heaters from scaling
Enhances soap lather and reduces detergent consumption
Keeps skin softer and hair healthier
Extends the life of appliances and bathroom fittings
Fully automatic operation with minimal maintenance

rows: Suitable for converting hard water into soft water
